column1: # Repo dispositions for check-uncommitted.py — path glob, disposition, note.
# live = local work is the working surface; stale uncommitted changes FAIL.
# scratch/archive = build/test clones whose canonical home is elsewhere; reported once as INFO, never FAIL.
# Unregistered repos default to live (fail-safe toward visibility).

column3: Example: throwaway clones; canonical home is the remote
